# Invariant tokens and arrays of parameterized results

This independent fixture keeps the same Object-bounded method formal inside
an invariant input token and each element's invariant nominal type. The
provider returns an existing array and declares an unchecked exception.

The immutable observer checks six raw, widened, ignored, generic, checked-read
and array-store routes, eighteen cases and two successive attempts. It observes
array identity, actual array classes, nulls, empty arrays, callback replacements,
element mutations, partial effects, late casts and exception identity. The token
does not predict array contents or runtime element types. Source and dependency
profiles compare all original definitions and metadata, including Exceptions.
Independent wrong programs must fail; metadata-only controls retain Code and
descriptors while changing generic relations or exception declarations.
